comment: Chains the Gnome saga owns. The Gnome route also walks the Dwarf chains (Shared_Alliance.lua).

chains.name: Gnomeregan in Exile
chains.summary: The gnomes of Gnomeregan in Exile labor on from Dun Morogh to Stormwind City. Their work begins in Kharanos, where Razzle Sprysprocket needs parts for Operation Recombobulation.

quests.task: Collect 8 Restabilization Cogs and 8 Gyromechanic Gears, then bring them to Razzle Sprysprocket in Kharanos, Dun Morogh.
Speak with Gnoarn in Ironforge, then travel to Loch Modan and find Bingles Blastenheimer.
Find Bingles' Wrench, Screwdriver, Hammer and Blastencapper in Loch Modan, then return them to Bingles Blastenheimer.
Speak with Gnoarn in Ironforge, then travel to Stormwind City and speak with Shoni the Shilent.
Retrieve the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket from the Deadmines and return it to Shoni the Shilent in Stormwind City.

chains.name: The Fall of Gnomeregan
chains.summary: The fallout of Gnomeregan reaches Stormwind City, Ironforge and Kharanos, where salvage, radioactive fallout and the death of Mekgineer Thermaplugg are sought from the fallen city.

quests.task: Take Shoni the Shilent's request in Stormwind City, gather twenty-four Robo-mechanical Guts in Gnomeregan, and bring them back to Shoni.
Take Brother Sarno's summons in Stormwind City, then travel to Ironforge and speak with Tinkmaster Overspark.
Enter Gnomeregan, recover Techbot's Memory Core, and bring it to Tinkmaster Overspark in Ironforge.
Take Gnoarn's message in Ironforge and speak with Ozzie Togglevolt in Kharanos, Dun Morogh.
Use the Empty Leaden Collection Phial on Irradiated Invaders or Irradiated Pillagers until it is full, then return to Ozzie Togglevolt in Kharanos.
Enter Gnomeregan, collect High Potency Radioactive Fallout, and hurry back to Ozzie Togglevolt in Kharanos before it collapses. Hand in the Heavy Leaden Collection Phial too.
Gather 12 Essential Artificials in Gnomeregan and bring them to Klockmort Spannerspan in Ironforge.
Recover a Prismatic Punch Card in Gnomeregan and bring it to Master Mechanic Castpipe in Ironforge.
Enter Gnomeregan and kill Mekgineer Thermaplugg, then return to High Tinker Mekkatorque in Ironforge.

routeTasks.65: Leave Stormwind City for Westfall and find Gryan Stoutmantle in the stone tower on Sentinel Hill. Begin his investigation: seek the contact who owes him a favor and can speak of the Brotherhood's leadership.
